exposure: Adnexal mass surgery in the first trimester of pregnancy
Adnexal mass surgery in the second trimester of pregnancy
cohort: 126 women who underwent adnexal mass surgery before 26 weeks of gestation at a university hospital between July 2008 and June 2018
finding: There were no significant differences in the rates of abortion, preterm birth, or cesarean delivery between women who underwent surgery for adnexal masses in the first trimester compared to those who underwent surgery in the second trimester.
